import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    g=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    lcol=None
    for c in range(w):
        u={g[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(u)==1 and int(next(iter(u)))!=bg: lcol=c
    bcs=[c for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and c!=lcol]
    bmin,bmax=min(bcs),max(bcs)
    bc=(bmin+bmax)/2
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h): out[r][round(bc-lcol+ (bmin+bmax)/2)] if False else None
    mir = round(2*bc - lcol)
    for r in range(h): out[r][mir]=8
    return out
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'], f(G['Demo pair 3 input'])==G['Demo pair 3 output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

        for i,j in cells:

        # 8-strip just beyond the far edge after the shift:

    else:                   # horizontal line across full width
        iline=next(i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]!=bg for j in range(w)))

        sh=iline-2-imax
        for i,j in cells:
            out[i][j]=bg; out[i+sh][j]=oc
        for j in range(w): out[iline-3][j]=8
    return out

steps.input:
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[k for k in cnt if k!=bg]
    lc=None; orient=None
    for c in others:
        cs=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        if len({i for i,_ in cs})==1 and len(cs)==w: lc=c; orient='H'; break
        if len({j for _,j in cs})==1 and len(cs)==h: lc=c; orient='V'; break
    oc=[c for c in others if c!=lc][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==oc]
    if orient=='H':
        iline=next(i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==lc for j in range(w)))
        imax=max(i for i,_ in cells)          # near edge (toward line)
        s=iline-1-imax                         # move so near edge at line-1
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg; out[i+s][j]=oc
        far=min(i for i,_ in [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==oc])
        tr=far+s                               # trailing edge after move
        for j in range(w): out[tr-1][j]=8
    else:
        jline=next(j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==lc for i in range(h)))
        maxj=max(j for _,j in cells)           # near edge
        sh=jline-1-maxj
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg; out[i][j+sh]=oc
        fl=min(j for _,j in cells)             # far edge
        tr=fl+sh
        for i in range(h): out[i][tr-1]=8
    return out
for p in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    print(p, f(G[p+' input'])==G[p+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

        if len({j for _,j in cs})==1 and len(cs)==h: lc=c; orient='V'; break
    oc=[c for c in others if c!=lc][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==oc]
